title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Kitcharao, Province of Agusan Del Norte, to Be Known as Kitcharao National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Kitcharao, Province of Agusan Del Norte, to Be Known as Kitcharao National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Poblacion, Thị trấn Kitcharao, Tỉnh Agusan Del Norte được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Kitcharao
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Poblacion, เทศบาล Kitcharao, จังหวัด Agusan Del Norte ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Kitcharao
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Poblacion, Kotamadya Kitcharao, Provinsi Agusan Del Norte dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Kitcharao
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Poblacion, Perbandaran Kitcharao, Wilayah Agusan Del Norte dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Kitcharao

text.en: A national high school is hereby established in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Kitcharao, Province of Agusan del Norte, to be known as the Kitcharao National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports (DECS) shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
